correctness.rationale: No 3-cells at length two. Each directed length-two shortcut (u,w) has exactly one intermediate neighbor by the absence of 4-cycles, so forms a unit free CW pair with its unique directed two-walk; absence of triangles ensures endpoints are at distance exactly two. The residual double-directed graph has two backtrack disks with the same coefficient-one attaching bigon per edge. Attaching one disk per edge retracts onto the usual graph; the remaining disk adds one S² per edge. Their primitive differences z_e exactly generate the integer boundary kernel, and endpoint reversal negates z_e, proving signed equivariance. The primitive backtrack loops generate precisely the edge-permutation kernel of stage-one-to-two H1. Exact integer chain definitions and boundary-square verified; finite mod-2/3/101 ranks and nine test graphs support but do not replace the general proof.

originality.rationale: The principal source proves the length-nerve filtration and the elementary backtrack death lemma but not the exact girth-five homotopy, primitive signed H2 edge lattice, or complete persistence kernel. The closest public high-girth Čech-prism result has exactly equal numerical wedge multiplicities, yet concerns the closed-ball nerve of G×K2 and has an unsigned H2 edge module, whereas this ordered nerve has a signed H2 lattice. That representation mismatch rules out objectwise equivariant equivalence and blocks simple implication. The prior special tree theorem does not cover graphs with cycles. Remaining risks of unindexed equivalent results explicitly persist.

value.rationale: Sharp structural homotopy and integral equivariant homology theorem for ALL connected graphs with girth at least five, including arbitrary branching and nonzero cycle rank. Identifies a natural early persistent kernel and distinguishes two otherwise numerically identical graph-derived constructions by opposite signed/unsigned homology modules. The threshold is motivated by unique two-edge geodesics, and triangle and quadrilateral counterexamples demonstrate that the boundary is genuine. The precise integral module and threshold are useful for comparisons of ordered length nerve topology and associated persistent magnitude homology.
